title: Spawn Herd
description: Configures group spawning behavior, including minimum and maximum herd size. Mobs like wolves, chickens, and zombies spawn in groups rather than individually. Also allows running events on the first N spawns or after M spawns.

event.title: Event
event.description: An event to run after M number of the herd have spawned

event_skip_count.title: Event Skip Count
event_skip_count.description: Number of the herd to skip before running the event

initial_event.title: Initial Event
initial_event.description: Event run for the first N of the herd are placed.

initial_event_count.title: Initial Event Count
initial_event_count.description: Number of times that the initial event will run

max_size.title: Max Size
max_size.description: Maximum number in this group to attempt to spawn

min_size.title: Min Size
min_size.description: Minimum number in this group to attempt to spawn
